brief.subject: IRS sets 2027 brackets; 6,500+ new opportunity zones
brief.headline: IRS Releases 2027 Inflation Adjustments as Treasury Names 6,500+ Opportunity Zones
brief.dek: New 2027 brackets and deduction figures, a fresh opportunity zone map, state ballot tax shifts, and an AICPA plea on estimated tax penalties.
brief.lede: The IRS has published tax year 2027 inflation adjustments for nearly 70 provisions, including brackets and the standard deduction. Year-end planning for 2027 can now start with official figures.

sections.heading: 2027 tax numbers are out
bullets: Nearly 70 provisions got tax year 2027 inflation adjustments from the IRS, so planning can now use official figures.
Income tax brackets and the standard deduction are among the updated items, affecting owners' and freelancers' 2027 projections.
Bookkeepers should refresh 2027 estimate and payroll planning templates once they review the new IRS tables.

sections.heading: New opportunity zone map
bullets: More than 6,500 communities now hold federal opportunity zone status, according to Treasury and the IRS.
The designations span all 50 states, the District of Columbia and five U.S. territories.
Owners weighing where to invest or expand should check whether their area made the new list.

sections.heading: Ballot results reshape state taxes
bullets: Florida voters approved Amendment 3, cutting property taxes; local governments now face decisions on which services to trim.
Colorado backers of Amendment 87 claim victory for a rewrite that would lift income taxes on high earners.
Washington's high-earner income tax stands after Initiative 645, the repeal effort, failed.
Business owners in these states should watch for rollout details that could change their tax bills.

sections.heading: Penalty relief sought for some trusts
bullets: The AICPA wants the IRS to waive 2026 estimated tax penalties for certain estates and trusts.
Uncertainty lingers over how a provision fits with the rules that specifically govern estates and trusts.
Practitioners handling fiduciary returns should watch for IRS guidance before estimated payments come due.

items.title: Proposed Rule: Guidance on Eligible Investments for Trump Accounts; Hearing
items.snippet: This document provides a notice of proposed rulemaking (CC- 00349938-26) published in the Federal Register on August 21, 2026. The proposed regulations provided guidance regarding eligible investments, which are the only assets in which the Trump account may be invested before the first day of the calendar year in which the account beneficiary attains 18.
